cvEn:
Shimshon Shertzer, son of Yaakov-Arie and Roza, was born on 7 Iyar 5696 (29 April 1936) in the city of Czernowitz in Bukovina. He completed his studies at an elementary school. The family immigrated to the country in 1950, and Shimshon studied for two years at the Youth Aliyah school in Givat Brenner.

He was a member of Kibbutz Shamir in the Upper Galilee. He was drafted into the IDF in October 1954. He fell in the course of his duty on 21 Adar 5716 (4 March 1956), and was laid to rest in the military cemetery in Netanya.
